==Description==
'''Slime''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 24 of the regular [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

Upon use, a large cube of green slime is about to hop towards the player, encasing over it.

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|625}} or {{Robux|87}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|6,895}} or {{Robux|1,450}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|109}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,825}}.
